text:
Maya: shift handoff quick: regen latency spike + partial 429s on /v1/chat for a subset of hosted customers starting ~02:12 UTC. Root cause looks like KV cache evictions on pool-hostpool-a leading to higher model calls. What I did: scaled pool-hostpool-a +2 nodes, flipped fallback to smaller-llm-v2 for affected customers, rolled a restart on two straggling inference pods. Observed 50% drop in 5xx after scale. Blockers: persistent KV eviction on hostpool-a nodes — disk I/O remains high on those instances. Need someone from eng-runtime to check kernel io sched config and investigate if `kubelet` evicts aggressively. Today: follow-up on PR to bump kvcache size, create a persistent alert for hostpool eviction rate, and coordinate with infra for instance replacement if disk pressure persists.

Sam: thanks, Maya. quick thing — PR #4281 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4281) is ready to bump default kvcache to 1.5GB for dedicated pools. It has perf numbers in the description. Can we canary that to hostpool-b first?

Maya: yes canary to hostpool-b only (us-west1) looks good. I already tagged the PR with `canary:hostpool-b` and scheduled a slow rollout.

Priya: I will own the alerting work. plan: add Alert `kvcache_eviction_rate > 0.05 for 5m` -> page eng-oncall, and add a dashboard chart for eviction rate + disk_iops. Will submit infra PR by EOD.

Alex: pinging runtime folks — @Sam @Maya please add a short repro / iostat output in the incident doc so infra can triage. Also can we have oncall-bot create Incident with tidy summary and links?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026. Summary: regen latency spike and kvcache eviction on hostpool-a. Linked items: PR #4281, logs: https://logs.redwood/ingest/2967890123, runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/regen-kvcache. Severity: P2.

Sam: added `iostat -xz` snippet to the incident doc and uploaded the small perf dump. baseline iowait on affected nodes was 18-25% at peak.

Maya: note — temporary mitigation applied: fallback routing to smaller-llm-v2 for affected tenancy t-42. We should consider a longer term config: increase persistent kvcache and tune eviction policy.

Priya: filing alert PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-infra/alerts/pull/112. cc @Alex for review.

Alex: I'll review the alert PR in ~30m. Also FYI I'll start a maintenance window request if disk pressure doesn't drop by 03:30 UTC.

Maya: handoff complete — leaving notes in INC-2026. Next oncall: Sam, you have the bridge if it reappears. I'll be reachable on slack. :thumbsup:

Sam: taking handoff. will watch alerts and follow up on PR canary. logged as `oncall:Sam` for next 8h.

Priya: thanks — will post updates to the incident thread if alert fires.

Alex: 👍
